title: SIMOTICS T Torque Motors — Direct-Drive Motor Families
locator: SIMOTICS T-1FW3 complete torque motor and T-1FW6 built-in torque motor integration distinctions
notes: The manufacturer distinguishes the complete 1FW3 motor with its mounting set from 1FW6 built-in stator/rotor components that require the machine bearing and encoder system for a complete drive unit. These statements apply to the listed Siemens families only; they do not define universal direct-drive construction. No product images or manuals are archived.
